subject.title: [Feature Request]: one-line local bootstrap for daemon + dashboard auth + Telegram owner setup

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class local bootstrap surface for Telegram owner setup, and if so should it require numeric owner allowlists or allow resolved usernames/preapproval while keeping pairing approval explicit?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the permanent public setup API and Telegram trust boundary are product/security choices rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add explicit allowlist bootstrap
options.body: Add narrow onboarding or bootstrap flags that configure gateway, dashboard URL output, Telegram token, and numeric owner allowlist/preapproval without unattended pairing approval.

options.title: Document current composition only
options.body: Keep the existing separate commands and improve docs, leaving one-line setup to external prompts or scripts.

options.title: Split into narrower issues
options.body: Route Telegram owner-default behavior to the existing allowlist issues and track daemon/dashboard bootstrap separately.

recommendation.title: Add explicit allowlist bootstrap
recommendation.body: Add narrow onboarding or bootstrap flags that configure gateway, dashboard URL output, Telegram token, and numeric owner allowlist/preapproval without unattended pairing approval.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans setup UX, dashboard auth, and security posture, where recent history and VISION ownership point to steipete as the best available decision owner.
